scope: Fixed selected palette/RCT/stream scope; Best learner and direct estimated ANS64 unchanged. Replay selected per-stream WP vector, then override every WP-eligible stream uniformly with each of five presets and refit every original learning scope. Selected vector is retained as a candidate. Complete native files and independent exact decodes determine rate. This does not enumerate independent per-stream assignments or other transforms/predictors/scopes. Single-pass timing is diagnostic only; managed memory includes retained baseline and candidate.
interpretation: The minimum tested complete file is an upper bound on the exhaustive optimum; the reported selected-policy rate loss is therefore a lower bound. Exceeding a search-loss gate falsifies it for any exhaustive domain containing these assignments. Passing this subset cannot qualify the exhaustive-search gate.
